articles.summary: Allianz just handed its global cyber book to a technology company because their technology meaningfully improves underwriting results. That is the milestone insurtech has been promising for a decade, and it’s finally arrived.
articles.title: Insurtech’s first real win and the emerging industry realignment behind it

articles.summary: Most of Shepherd's architecture existed to compensate for our coordination limits, but AI-driven development removed that need to compensate. We merged our polyrepo into a monorepo, collapsed it into a single Next.js monolith, and cut our development cycle from nearly an hour to under 10 minutes.
articles.title: Back to the Monolith: AI Cost, Context, and our Changing Priorities
